map.都能。\\x41 是十六进制转义，\\101 是八进制转义（101 八进制 =: Yes. \x41 is a hexadecimal escape and \101 an octal one (101 octal = 65 decimal = 'A'). map.先去掉首尾空白，存在成对外层双引号或单引号时去掉外层引号。逐字符扫描：遇到反斜杠: Trim the input, and remove one pair of surrounding double or single quotes if present. Scan character by character: on a backslash with a following character, escape by the next character — n to newline, r to carriage return, t to tab, b to backspace, f to form feed, v to vertical tab, 0 to NUL, a to bell, and backslash, single/double quote, and question mark to themselves; after x take up to 2 hex digits and parse them as base-16 code points; when the next character is an octal digit take up to 3 octal digits and parse as base-8 code points; otherwise take the next character itself. Non-escape characters are kept as-is.
